Upload & validation — three sizes genuinely enforced, storage abstracted, editor-readable errors
Publish job — atomic, recorded, idempotent, language grouping correct
API design & auth — sensible resources, roles enforced, honest errors, filters compose
Data modelling — schema fits the queries, indexes justified, clean migrations
CMS usability — an editor could use it unaided, all states handled
Viewer UI — hero/rows/detail correct, right artwork per surface, search & filters, empty states
Pipeline & operability — compose works first try, CI meaningful, secrets & alerting reasoned
Things that will count against you:

publishing by overwriting the live file · artwork accepted at any size · roles declared but never enforced · client-side-only validation · search done in the browser over the whole catalogue with no comment on scale · the viewer UI calling admin endpoints ·
If something's ambiguous, make a decision, note it in the README, and move on — that's what we'd want on the job too. If you're genuinely blocked, email [contact] and we'll answer within a few hours.
